title: My last holiday
instructions: Emma geçen yazki tatilini anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; geçmiş zamandaki fiillere ve yerlere dikkat et.

script.speaker: emma
script.text: Last summer, I went to Greece with my family.

script.speaker: emma
script.text: We flew from London to Athens. The flight took about four hours.

script.speaker: emma
script.text: We stayed in Athens for three days and visited the old city.

script.speaker: emma
script.text: It was very hot, so we drank a lot of water and wore hats.

script.speaker: emma
script.text: Then we took a boat to a small island called Naxos.

script.speaker: emma
script.text: Our hotel there was next to the beach.

script.speaker: emma
script.text: Every morning, I swam in the sea before breakfast.

script.speaker: emma
script.text: My brother learned to sail, but I was too scared to try.

script.speaker: emma
script.text: The food was delicious. My favourite was the Greek salad with fresh cheese.

script.speaker: emma
script.text: On the last day, I bought some postcards and a blue bag for my best friend.

script.speaker: emma
script.text: It was the best holiday of my life.

questions.prompt: How did Emma's family travel to Athens?
questions.feedback: "We flew" uçakla gittik demek (fly → flew). Tekne Naxos adasına gitmek için.
questions.evidence: We flew from London to Athens.

questions.prompt: What did Emma do every morning on Naxos?
questions.feedback: Her sabah kahvaltıdan önce denizde yüzdü (swam). Yelkeni kardeşi öğrendi.
questions.evidence: Every morning, I swam in the sea before breakfast.

questions.prompt: What did Emma buy for her best friend?
questions.feedback: Kartpostalları kendisi için aldı; en iyi arkadaşına mavi bir çanta (a blue bag) aldı.
questions.evidence: a blue bag for my best friend.
